how_the_run_was_made: Full 121438-cell collected set. The whole golden directory does not fit one tool call, so it was run in 18 `-k` shards via scripts/verifier_golden_shards.sh and merged by nodeid with scripts/verifier_merge_golden_shards.py. Full JSON (75 MB) at generated/verifier_results/verifier_report.json (gitignored).
